initialFailures.setup: Initial validator read a stale enabled Continue button immediately after posting Install, then queued a click during the asynchronous operation. Failure cleanup raced setup/dismiss with main close and masked the original timeout. Recheck waits completed-operation text and main editing controls becoming enabled. Same application bytes passed.
initialFailures.results: Initial ordinary-path fixture selected the receiver immediately after a socket drop, before the asynchronous connection was applied. Recheck waits producer Used by text before selecting the receiver and retains the original From assertions. Same application bytes passed in both paths.

checks: All 32 current packs coexist after Full setup through signed catalogue verification and the native importer.
With all 32 packs installed, offline native alignment and SAM-to-BAM analysis preserves all 202 expected records.
Installed BEDTools contributes a usable BED workflow input through the normal pack-driven input list.
All 32 installed packs and setup state reopen with socket operations denied; individual-tool selection remains usable.
unrun: Production signed catalogue refresh and clean-client Full installation are not exercised by test-only trust fixtures.
fullCoexistence.scope: Real immutable GitHub pack downloads and actual native importer under isolated test-only publisher trust. Not the unavailable official signed feed. No claim that every pack scientific fixture ran.

productionTrust.reason: No maintainer-controlled signing source/key provisioning was available. Source list remains empty. Test-only keys do not establish production trust.

limits: Setup GUI tests cover native first-run/profile selection, minimum sizing, offline Starter and reopening. Signed batch transfers use the packaged backend under isolated test transport, not live production GUI downloads.
All-pack coexistence does not rerun every scientific operation of every pack.
References reports retain an unrequested optional updater skip; a separate exact 0.9.0-to-0.10.0 update suite passed in both paths.
Physical trackpads, alternate display drivers/DPI, institutional policies and clinical validation are outside these checks.
Artifact static audit is separate from native execution and did not independently rebuild the executable.
Offline denial is a Python audit hook rejecting private-host socket operations, not an OS firewall or network blockade of native subprocesses.
